extracted.name: Khichda/daleem/mutton porridge 😊
ingredient_lines: 500 gms whole wheat/harees,350 gms pearl white wheat
Lentils 2 spoon each pink masoor,yellow mung dal,Bengal gram
White mash dal,soak all these overnight
Mutton masala.1 onion, 5 tbsn ginger garlic n chilli paste
1 tomato, 2 tbsn red chilli pwd,2 tbsn turmeric pwd,1 tbsn
Coriander pwd,2 tbsn salt and few whole garam masala cardamom
Garnish 2 onions,few coriander leaves, sliced ginger, mint
2 tbsn garam masala n Biryani masala(for this masala check
Note take big vessel to make this recipe
instruction_lines: First grind coarsely boil the soaked ingredients 8 cups of water with little whole garam masala,few slit green chillies, coriander n mint leaves with little salt.

Now its boiled n done add more water if required. Now heat one cup of oil then add whole garam masala as above given then add 1 sliced onion when brown add the mutton saute with salt n the masala ginger garlic and chilli paste,then add the dry masala n tomato now cook till done.

Mutton is done now transfer it into boiled mixture n let the porridge simmer.now fry 2 onions in one cup oil,when brown remove the onions with few remaining with oil now put this oil on porridge n let it simmer check the consistency.
Things u need to garnish. Lastly add the powdered garam masala n Biryani masala(optional)mix well n serve hot.enjoy this winter season 😊
